device.name: JK Inverter BMS (BLE)
device.description: JK Inverter BMS with Bluetooth Low Energy interface for LiFePO4 battery packs. Supports up to 32 cells, charge/discharge/balance control, and comprehensive protection. Connects wirelessly via BLE GATT service 0xFFE0.

fast.description: Real-time sensor data — cell voltages, pack status, temperatures

slow.description: Read once per connection — avoids repeated BLE command writes that cause the BMS to beep
